summary: Study in Brown is a 1955 EmArcy Records album by Clifford Brown and Max Roach, made up mostly of original compositions by the band members. Two of its tracks, "Lands End" by Harold Land and "Sandu" by Brown, became jazz standards. The note also highlights Brown's solo on "Cherokee" as one of the most acclaimed solos in jazz.
one_line: Study in Brown is a 1955 EmArcy Records album by Clifford Brown and Max Roach featuring mostly band-written originals.
key_facts: Study in Brown was released by EmArcy Records in 1955.
Study in Brown is a Clifford Brown and Max Roach album.
The album consists predominantly of originals by members of the band.
"Lands End" was written by tenor saxophonist Harold Land.
"Lands End" has become a jazz standard.
"George's Dilemma" is also known as "Ulcer Department".
Clifford Brown's solo on "Cherokee" is among the most acclaimed solos in jazz.
